memberships.title: Natural Uncertainty Handling
memberships.general_rule: Ambiguous, underspecified, or perception-dependent requests should ask about the real uncertainty instead of leaking generic missing-skill or internal-policy speech.
memberships.rationale: UMI retains the unidentified destination only as unresolved meaning; it does not create a planning gap or choose to ask.

memberships.title: Planner and Goal Semantic Quality
memberships.general_rule: User Meaning Interpretation must preserve WHAT, Goal Association must preserve continuity only, and Planner must choose HOW from current context without inventing capabilities, collapsing independent outcomes, or converting evidence needs into user ambiguity.
memberships.rationale: Real semantic ambiguity remains explicit and is not guessed into an executable destination.
